Name: Dutch Farm Buildings - CURRENTLY OUTDATED
Author: minervamaga
TagLine: Turn your buildings into Dutchie style. Comes with optional Tractor Garage and Winery textures!
Description:
Hi all, Minerva here!  This mod will hopefully be updated sometime soon so you can continue to enjoy it <3  It will be moving to Moddrop as well, for better moderation of asset use.

<s>Please read the instructions carefully. It's not hard to install at all so don't worry and don't get overwhelmed by the wall of text, it's just a very detailed step by step description. Some of it you might already know. Enjoy! :-)
</s>
_How to install SMAPI Version_
- If you wanna use the SMAPI version, you MUST install [SMAPI](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Installing_SMAPI). Also installing [Seasonal Immersion](https://community.playstarbound.com/resources/smapi-seasonal-immersion.4262/) (which is a SMAPI mod) is a must.

Step 1: Install [SMAPI](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Installing_SMAPI). Refer to the install instructions on the SMAPI page I have linked.
Step 2: Install[Seasonal Immersion](https://community.playstarbound.com/resources/smapi-seasonal-immersion.4262/). Refer to the install instructions on the SI page I have linked.
Step 3: Download my Dutch Buildings Contentpack which I have provided on nexus, here. (choose 'SMAPI Dutch Farm Buildings' under __main files__)
Step 4: Extract the .zip file with an unpacker of your choice, i.e. WinRar.
Step 5: Put the ContentPack folder, which you unpacked from the zipfile, in Seasonal Immersion. See the image.
Step 6: You have not installed Junimo Huts.xnb yet. You need to do this manually, see 'How to install XNB Version' on how to install Junimo Huts/an xnb file. I have included a Junimo Huts.xnb in this download, so you don't have to download the XNB Dutch Farm buildings version. 
Step 7: You have not installed the Tractor Garage for the [Tractor Mod](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1401) yet. See 'How to install seasonal Tractor Garage' on how to do this.
Step 8: You have not installed the Winery for the [Winery](https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/winery-brewery-retexture-mod-assets-completed.114143/page-7) mod yet. See 'How to install Winery' on how to do this.
Step 9: You're done, go play!
![](https://i.imgur.com/oKbadT4.png)

_How to install XNB Version_
Step 1: [find the Buildings folder.  ](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_FAQs#Game_folder)It's inside 'Content', in 'Stardew Valley'. Skip to step 5 if you only need to install Junimo Huts.xnb
Step 2: Download my Dutch Farm Buildings from this nexus page. (choose 'XNB Pack Dutch Farm Buildings' under __optional files__)
Step 3: Extract the .zip file with an unpacker of your choice, i.e. WinRar.
Step 4: Depending on the season you're in, choose the season specific xnb files to use. I.e. Choose winter if you're in winter right now, or spring if you're in spring. Or choose whichever seasonal files you want to use, it's your life.
Step 5: Copy the xnb files, go to the Buildings folder, and paste the copied xnb files in there. Let it replace all the game's files.
Step 6: Depending on if you want to use all the seasonal specific files for each season, you're going to have to repeat step 4 and 5 every time you change seasons in-game. Seasonal Immersion is a mod that automates this process, but if you're unable to use SMAPI, you need to replace the seasonal files each time yourself.
Step 7: You're done!
![](https://i.imgur.com/0wD5Kdz.png)

_(Optional) How to install seasonal Tractor Garage_
There are two ways for installing the Tractor Garage.

__**The Seasonal Immersion/XNB Placeholder way:
**__Step 1: Assuming you have installed SMAPI by now, install [Tractor Mod](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1401)____as described on that page, if you haven't already.
Step 2: Go to your Buildings folder (see Step 1 'How to install XNB Version' on how to find it), and copy paste a random building xnb. I.e., copy paste 'Stable.xnb' and rename it to 'TractorGarage.xnb'. You have now created a placeholder xnb, which is needed for Seasonal Immersion to read.
Step 3: Download 'TractorGarage Seasonal Immersion Version' from this nexus page, under __optional__ __files__.
Step 4: Extract the .zip file to reveal the seasonal TractorGarage.png's inside, each in a separate folder.
Step 5: Assuming you have installed Seasonal Immersion by now; go there in Mods, drop the corresponding seasonal TractorGarage.png in each seasonal (spring, summer, fall, winter) folder, with the rest of the seasonal building png files. This will not work unless you have created the XNB Placeholder.
Step 6: You're done, go play man!
![](https://i.imgur.com/TLaWoXS.png)![](https://i.imgur.com/0GCYyU5.png)

__**The Tractor Mod Assets folder way:
**__Step 1: Assuming you have installed SMAPI by now, install [Tractor Mod](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1401)____as described on that page, if you haven't already.
Step 2: Download 'TractorGarage Assets folder Version' from this nexus page, under __optional files__.
Step 3: Extract the .zip file to reveal 'spring_TractorHouse.png', 'summer_TractorHouse.png', 'winter_TractorHouse.png' and 'fall_TractorHouse.png' inside.
Step 4: Go to the installed Tractor Mod folder inside Mods, and find the 'assets' folder.
Step 5: Drop the 'spring/summer/winter/fall_TractorHouse.png' inside the assets folder. Tractor Mod will now see it can use seasonal files for the building.
Step 6: You're done!
__Note: This will only work in the 4.2 update, which was not released yet for the Tractor Mod! For now you will have to use the Seasonal Immersion/XNB Placeholder way. You can also read the [github](https://github.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/tree/develop/TractorMod#custom-textures) page for info on the Tractor Mod.
__![](https://i.imgur.com/HwrxKcA.png)

_(Optional) How to install Winery.
_The Winery is a texture specially made for[this winery mod](https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/winery-brewery-retexture-mod-assets-completed.114143/). The texture is made from the Slime Hutch.png, which means you can choose to use this winery to only replace the Slime Hutch in Seasonal Immersion. But you can also use these two Slime Hutch textures at the same time, side by side. But you will need [Customize Exterior](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1099) for this!
Step 1: Assuming you have installed SMAPI by now, install [Customize Exterior ](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1099)like any SMAPI mod. If you don't want to use CE and only want to use this texture to replace the current Slime Hutch texture, skip to step 6.
Step 2: Download 'Winery Customize Exterior Version' from this nexus page, under __optional files.__
Step 3: Extract the .zip file to reveal the folder 'Seasonal_Immersion' inside. 
Step 4: Go to Customize Exterior in Mods, find the buildings folder and place the 'Seasonal_Immersion' folder in its entirety in there. CE will now see it has Seasonal Textures installed inside.
Step 5: You're done, you can double right click on your Slime Hutch in-game to choose the new Winery texture!
![](https://i.imgur.com/Z5XpDNd.png)

Step 6: Download 'Winery Seasonal Immersion Version' from this nexus page under __optional files.__
Step 7: Extract the .zip file to reveal the 'spring, summer, fall and winter' folders inside. In there are the Winery's seasonal png's, they're called 'Slime Hutch'.
Step 8: Go to your Seasonal Immersion folder in Mods, and drag and drop the seasonal png's accordingly in the folder. Let it overwrite the old 'Slime Hutch'.
Step 9: You're done!
![](https://i.imgur.com/FS5rCCj.png)

_Disclaimer_
- If something doesn't work or show up, it's cause you have installed it incorrectly or a SMAPI mod is not working. I can't help either of those issues.
- Bug reports should go to the corresponding SMAPI mod, don't report them here. These are merely textures you're downloading. Bugs are SMAPI or SMAPI Mods related.
- This set does not include the gold clock or obelisks, I won't make those either as I see them rarely used in-game.
- Please do not re-upload anywhere. Edits for personal use are okay!
- Feel free to share screenshots of your farm!

_Known 'bugs'_
- This mod is purely aesthetical, which means there will be some conflict with the houses. i.e. your spouse will stand on some potted plants on the right and you will walk over the wall. That's just the way I made it, I won't fix it because it would mean I have to redesign/resprite the whole house.
- The shadows don't really match on the floor.
- The smoke doesn't come directly out of the chimney, it's more or less right beside it.
